definition: Uses avatar motion to inspect or compare posture, limb path, body angle, racket-side movement, or whole-body form.
coding_rule: Include: The account specifies visible form made comparable by avatar motion. Exclude: General usefulness or muscle-only timing/force comments. Boundary: Pair with C02/C03 when form and activation are interpreted jointly. Note: Describes access to visible information, not learning or motion superiority.

code_name: Muscle cue for force, relaxation, or timing
definition: Interprets muscle-related display content as information about activation magnitude, release, timing, muscle location, or grip/impact force.
coding_rule: Include: Force, relaxation, activation site, or timing is linked to the muscle display. Exclude: General liking or outcome change without a muscle-information role. Boundary: C03 captures joint interpretation with motion; C06 captures temporal representation. Note: Codes perceived use, not physiological correctness or an isolated EMG effect.

code_name: Bundled muscle information as a complement to motion
definition: Describes the muscle layer as adding detail to or being interpreted jointly with the motion reference.
coding_rule: Include: Muscle information fills a perceived gap in motion or acts as supporting information. Exclude: Preference without a joint informational account. Boundary: Distinct from C02, which does not require comparison with motion. Note: Supports configuration-level claims only.

definition: Reports different usefulness, interpretability, or attentional priorities for forehand and backhand.
coding_rule: Include: Feedback value explicitly changes by stroke. Exclude: A stroke is named only as context. Boundary: C05 codes familiarity as one possible explanation. Note: Preserve divergent directions; do not impose one favored stroke.

definition: Attributes feedback value or difficulty partly to prior familiarity, forgotten technique, or stroke novelty.
coding_rule: Include: Prior experience or novelty is used to explain value/difficulty. Exclude: Biomechanical-demand explanation without familiarity. Boundary: Related to C04 but not equivalent to it. Note: Familiarity is an account, not a measured moderator.

definition: Values a plotted time trace because it remains available or makes similarity/difference more legible than rapidly unfolding motion.
coding_rule: Include: The account contrasts waveform persistence/legibility with unfolding motion. Exclude: Muscle-feedback benefit without representation-format reasoning. Boundary: C07 separates real-time bars from replay; C14 captures reward. Note: Representation format is the operative distinction.

definition: Distinguishes monitoring during the stroke from post-stroke review.
coding_rule: Include: The account explicitly describes different use or non-use of real-time and replay displays. Exclude: Replay-control issues without a real-time contrast. Boundary: C06 is graph persistence; C13 is replay frequency. Note: Assign delivery phase only when it is recoverable from the account.

code_name: Noticing a discrepancy from the expert reference
definition: Detects or tracks similarity/difference between user and expert motion or muscle representations.
coding_rule: Include: A displayed match/mismatch is noticed or monitored. Exclude: A difference is supplied only by the interviewer. Boundary: C09 adds uncertainty; C10 adds a proposed action. Note: Noticing is not understanding.

code_name: Causal or action ambiguity of a discrepancy
definition: Notices a mismatch or similarity but cannot infer its cause, correctness, attainability, or a specific corrective action.
coding_rule: Include: The account lacks a clear explanation or actionable implication. Exclude: A concrete candidate action resolves the ambiguity in that segment. Boundary: C20 requires an explicit missing-guidance need. Note: Detection and actionability must remain separate.

definition: Converts feedback into a candidate next action involving posture, force, relaxation, grip, timing, or attention.
coding_rule: Include: A specific next-step adjustment is proposed. Exclude: Vague helpfulness or an interviewer-supplied suggestion. Boundary: C11 captures perceived consequence checking. Note: A candidate action is not assumed correct or effective.

code_name: Verification through shuttle, sound, or impact cues
definition: Uses perceived shuttle flight, direction, distance, consistency, impact sound, or impact feel to judge a candidate adjustment.
coding_rule: Include: Outcome/contact cues are used in sensemaking. Exclude: Objective measures or general enjoyment. Boundary: Pair with C10 for a notice-hypothesize-check sequence. Note: These are perceived checks, not measured effects.

definition: Narrows attention to one cue/body area/goal or alternates action and inspection to manage multiple information sources.
coding_rule: Include: A concrete attentional-management strategy is described. Exclude: Clutter without a strategy. Boundary: C13 is when replay is consulted; C15 is competition cost. Note: Strategy and trade-off may co-occur.

definition: Consults replay occasionally, after a selected stroke, or when a question prompts review.
coding_rule: Include: Review is participant-initiated or need-triggered. Exclude: Required replay cadence or continuous monitoring. Boundary: C12 is cue selection; C17 is interaction overhead. Note: Do not infer a fixed frequency without source support.

code_name: Reward and salience of waveform matching
definition: Describes waveform matching or an explicit muscle target as engaging, rewarding, motivating, or attention-capturing.
coding_rule: Include: Engagement is tied to a visible target or waveform match. Exclude: General enjoyment with no information target. Boundary: C15 captures salience that competes with posture. Note: Questionnaire findings should bound motivational interpretation.

definition: Added content competes for attention, makes the display busy, or shifts focus away from another relevant cue.
coding_rule: Include: The cost arises from multiple visual/informational elements. Exclude: Field of view, weight, or control effort alone. Boundary: Distinguish C16-C18. Note: Content and salience are bundled in this configuration.

code_name: Readability constraint from FOV, scale, or layout
definition: Graphs, avatars, shuttle path, or comparison details are hard to see because of field of view, scale, placement, or angle.
coding_rule: Include: Visibility and legibility are the primary issue. Exclude: Manipulation effort or physical discomfort alone. Boundary: C17 is control overhead; C18 is wearability. Note: Often a headset/setup constraint rather than a muscle-content effect.

definition: Effort or missing controls affect triggering, moving to, pausing, scrubbing, rotating, scaling, toggling, synchronizing, or overlaying replay content.
coding_rule: Include: The problem concerns obtaining or manipulating the desired replay view. Exclude: Display-size or equipment discomfort alone. Boundary: C13 concerns strategic frequency; C16 concerns visibility. Note: Much of the replay workflow is shared by both AR configurations.

definition: Headset or sensors add weight, rub, slip, obstruct, alter grip/gaze, create fear of dropping, or affect execution.
coding_rule: Include: A physical device changes comfort or movement. Exclude: Visual clutter or control usability with no physical effect. Boundary: Distinct from C16/C17. Note: Do not attribute shared apparatus costs to the muscle layer.

definition: Questions direct trace matching because of individual body size, strength, fatigue, pain, baseline technique, or expert-novice difference.
coding_rule: Include: Individual characteristics are invoked to qualify reference matching. Exclude: Generic missing instruction or display readability. Boundary: Related to C09/C20. Note: The account does not validate a physiological cause.

definition: Lacks an explicit indication of what to change, where to focus, how much to change, or what alignment is acceptable.
coding_rule: Include: A corrective direction or threshold is missing. Exclude: Personalization concern with no guidance need. Boundary: C21 concerns contact/outcome context. Note: Do not invent a requested threshold not present in source accounts.

code_name: Missing contact-point, racket-angle, or outcome guidance
definition: Identifies missing shuttle-contact point, racket angle, expert shuttle trajectory, or target-outcome information.
coding_rule: Include: Contact or outcome context is needed to interpret form/EMG. Exclude: Generic correction guidance unrelated to contact/outcome. Boundary: Related to C20. Note: Indicates a boundary of form/EMG-only sensemaking.

definition: Reports a perceived improvement in understanding, posture, force use, contact, or shuttle outcome during the brief study.
coding_rule: Include: The participant positively describes an immediate change. Exclude: Researcher inference, objective result, or hypothetical long-term benefit only. Boundary: Consider C23 when the account is qualified. Note: Must be reported as perception, not learning.

code_name: Uncertainty about embodiment, learning, or outcome attribution
definition: Qualifies whether understanding became embodied, performance truly changed, or change came from feedback rather than repetition, fatigue, or chance.
coding_rule: Include: The account expresses uncertainty or an alternative explanation. Exclude: Unqualified positive progress. Boundary: Complements but should not be merged with C22. Note: Directly bounds learning and causal claims.

code_name: No Feedback lacks a comparison reference
definition: Describes No Feedback as ordinary, guess-based, or outcome-only practice without an expert comparison or structured basis for correction.
coding_rule: Include: The account explicitly contrasts No Feedback with a reference-supported condition. Exclude: Motion-Only versus Motion+Muscle comparison only. Boundary: Context code, not focal component evidence. Note: No Feedback also lacks AR and replay, so comparisons are contextual.

definition: Proposes brief human instruction to supply action/contact context while the system supports repeated self-review.
coding_rule: Include: Human and system roles are complementary. Exclude: General mention of coaches. Boundary: Related to C20/C21. Note: A design implication, not a tested deployment model.
